host_operation_rule.payload_transfer: Thrust-off/coast only. Storage gate cannot open under thrust; continuous capped channel and far-stop proof contain possible low-friction drift. Commanded pusher deceleration does not pull the satellite or establish its final pose.
host_operation_rule.launch: Verified host burn OFF for >=5s and stable-attitude proof required; unexpected burn while armed inhibits release and resets the timer
host_operation_rule.guard_clock_model: WAIT_HOST_GUARD advances an explicit one-second model tick while thrust is off; five consecutive ticks are required. Any restart resets elapsed time. This is a timed logic specification, not a flight clock implementation.

assumed_physical_contracts: Continuous capped channel, fixed rear boundary and proved far receiver stops provide containment; near capture tabs close only after sensed seating. Pusher and normally engaged brake do not guarantee free-payload deceleration or pose.
Two independent position/path proof signals are truthful when agreement is accepted
Power loss inhibits release; the payload may coast within the contained transfer volume. Far-stop impacts, rebound and settling are not rated by the logic model.
